messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr/lyx error 'Invalid cross-device link'
parts:
For the warning message, I think we have fixed it in LyX 2.0.5. It
seems you are using an old version of LyX, so please try to update LyX
first (the latest version now is 2.0.6).

I do not understand the error message about the missing file. You may
need to send a minimal example.

Regards,
Yihui

On Fri, May 24, 2013 at 4:39 AM, Pete Phillips <pete...@googlemail.com> wrote:
> I have a simple lyx document on an NFS mounted partition. When I try to
> view the PDF within lyx (View/View (pdflatex), I get an error in the
> terminal where I launched lyx:
>
> Warning message:
> In file.rename(basename(.cmdargs[2]), .cmdargs[2]) :
> cannot rename file 'Normal-01.tex' to
> '/tmp/lyx_tmpdir.XM7719/lyx_tmpbuf2/Normal-01.tex', reason 'Invalid
> cross-device link'
>
> In the PDF file, the knitR sections says:
>
> ## Error: Intermediate file ’/tmp/RtmpoWRDQo/file22294518d3ba.csv’ missing!
> ## Error: invalid ’file’ argument
> ## Error: object ’interlab’ not found
>
> However, if I copy the directory I am using across to my main hard drive,
> everything works OK.
>
> So it appears that one of the components (and I suspect the knitR module in
> Lyx) is trying to create a hard (?) link across file systems to create a
> temporary directory to process the lyx code, but the link creation fails on
> our NFS stuff but works on local drives ?
>
> Has anyone a solution for this ?
>
> Pete

messages.author: 7721e8b8c22283f0
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr/lyx error 'Invalid cross-device link'
parts:
Thanks - upgrading to the latest lyx from the ppa:lyx-devel/release PPA  fixed it.  

The missing file error was due to the fact that the link failed and therefore the file was not in /tmp where it was supposed to be.

Thanks again.
Pete
